arguments.name: appliedFor
arguments.description: (Required) Which features this template applies to. Must contain one or more of `PULL_THROUGH_CACHE` or `REPLICATION`.

arguments.name: customRoleArn
arguments.description: (Optional) A custom IAM role to use for repository creation. Required if using repository tags or KMS encryption.

arguments.name: imageTagMutability
arguments.description: (Optional) The tag mutability setting for any created repositories. Must be one of: `MUTABLE` or `IMMUTABLE`. Defaults to `MUTABLE`.

arguments.name: lifecyclePolicy
arguments.description: (Optional) The lifecycle policy document to apply to any created repositories. See more details about [Policy Parameters](http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/LifecyclePolicies.html#lifecycle_policy_parameters) in the official AWS docs. Consider using the [`aws_ecr_lifecycle_policy_document` data_source](/docs/providers/aws/d/ecr_lifecycle_policy_document.html) to generate/manage the JSON document used for the `lifecyclePolicy` argument.

arguments.name: prefix
arguments.description: (Required, Forces new resource) The repository name prefix to match against. Use `ROOT` to match any prefix that doesn't explicitly match another template.

arguments.name: repositoryPolicy
arguments.description: (Optional) The registry policy document to apply to any created repositories. This is a JSON formatted string. For more information about building IAM policy documents with Terraform, see the [AWS IAM Policy Document Guide](https://learn.hashicorp.com/terraform/aws/iam-policy).

arguments.name: resourceTags
arguments.description: (Optional) A map of tags to assign to any created repositories.

arguments.name: encryptionType
arguments.description: (Optional) The encryption type to use for any created repositories. Valid values are `AES256` or `KMS`. Defaults to `AES256`.

arguments.name: kmsKey
arguments.description: (Optional) The ARN of the KMS key to use when `encryptionType` is `KMS`. If not specified, uses the default AWS managed key for ECR.
